name: Hametsu no Majo
source:
[i]“Now, let us begin this most frenzied of witch trials!”[/i]

[i]Frenzy of Fury and Loathing[/i]

A witch who brings ruin to all, and Rune's enemy. He bequeaths incredible powers to people and enjoys watching the subsequent discord and suspicion they cause among other humans. He's unscrupulous and deranged, sadistic and cold-blooded. And no one knows what, exactly, he wants.

[spoiler]His real name is Ish.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=witch]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
